This is the first script one should run before using any R scripts or genotyping functions. All editable settings are in the YAML header above or in Master_Pipeline.Rmd (settings_01), with comments explaining the settings. All paths are written from the project folder (Full_workflow), except full paths for preinstalled tools. 
After completing this script, move on to 01b_ObiTools4_Demultiplexing.Rmd



## Settings, paths and basic setup
Chunk contains settings, paths to the installed tools and a timing function for speed optimization analysis.

```{r setup}
suppressMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
})

# Uploading shared functions
source("Code/R_scripts/asp_functions.R", local = TRUE) 

# Empty timing log for calculating elapsed time, all the scripts use the same shared function
timing_log <- list() 

# Settings come from the params block in the YAML header, this turns them into usable variables
invisible(list2env(params, envir = environment()))

# Paths to the installed Dorado and ObiTools4 directories so R can find the commands
login_shell_path <- tryCatch(system2(Sys.getenv("SHELL", "/bin/zsh"), c("-ilc", shQuote("echo $PATH")), stdout = TRUE, stderr = FALSE, timeout = 10), error = function(e) "", warning = function(w) "") # PATH from the user's terminal settings, RStudio does not read them
tool_search_folders <- unique(path.expand(c(dorado_bin_folder, # YAML folders first, a set path always wins
                                            strsplit(tail(c("", login_shell_path), 1), ":")[[1]],
                                            rev(Sys.glob(path.expand(c("~/*/bin", "~/*/*/bin", "~/*/*/*/bin")))), # unpacked anywhere in the home folder, newest version first
                                            Sys.glob(path.expand(c("~/*conda*/bin", "~/*conda*/envs/*/bin", "~/mambaforge/envs/*/bin"))), # conda installs
                                            "/usr/local/bin", "/opt/homebrew/bin", Sys.glob("/opt/*/bin"))))
needed_tools <- c("dorado")
tool_folders <- sapply(needed_tools, function(tool) {
  found_in <- tool_search_folders[file.exists(file.path(tool_search_folders, tool))]
  if (length(found_in) == 0) stop(tool, " not found. Install it, or paste its bin folder into the YAML (dorado_bin_folder / obitools_bin_folder)")
  found_in[1]
})
Sys.setenv(PATH = paste(c(unique(tool_folders), Sys.getenv("PATH")), collapse = ":")) # only the folders that hold the tools are added
cat("Using:\n", paste(file.path(tool_folders, needed_tools), collapse = "\n "), "\n")

tool_paths <- Sys.which("dorado")
if (any(tool_paths == "")) stop("not found: ", paste(names(tool_paths)[tool_paths == ""], collapse = ", "),
                                ". Install it, or paste its bin folder into dorado_bin_folder / obitools_bin_folder in the YAML")
cat("Using:\n", paste(tool_paths, collapse = "\n "), "\n")

barcode_numbers <- sprintf("%02d", seq_len(n_barcodes))
demultiplexed_folder <- file.path("Data/Processed_data", dataset_name, "Demultiplexed_sequence_data")
dorado_output_folder <- file.path(demultiplexed_folder, "Dorado_demultiplexed_by_sample")
dir.create(dorado_output_folder, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
identified_folder <- file.path(demultiplexed_folder, "Identified_sample_sequences_Obi4")
unidentified_folder <- file.path(demultiplexed_folder, "Unidentified_sample_sequences_Obi4")
dir.create(identified_folder, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(unidentified_folder, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Settings used each run saved directly inside the output folder, useful for reproducibility
settings_used <- data.frame(setting = c("run_date", names(params)),
                            value = c(format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
                                      vapply(params, function(setting_value) paste(setting_value, collapse = ", "), character(1))))

write.table(settings_used, file.path(demultiplexed_folder, "Dorado_demultiplexed_by_sample/settings_used_01.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
write.table(settings_used, file.path(demultiplexed_folder, "Identified_sample_sequences_Obi4/settings_used_01.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
write.table(settings_used, file.path(demultiplexed_folder, "Unidentified_sample_sequences_Obi4/settings_used_01.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```

## First demultiplexing: Dorado demux
This chunk creates Dorado demultiplexed sequence data which is separated/demultiplexed by sample and creates one unclassified sequence data file.
Basic Dorado "demux" bash command line function converted to run in R. User should first install the Dorado toolbox using the command line and paste the path to its bin directory into dorado_bin_folder. The input is the single basecalled .bam or .fastq file in Data/Raw_data/dataset_name (the small dataset is a .bam, the big one a .fastq because of its naming structure). After executing this chunk user can find Dorado's demultiplexed sequences separated into samples, plus unclassified sequences which weren't able to be confidently assigned to a specific Nanopore barcode.

```{r First_Demultiplexing_Dorado_Demux, class.output = "scroll-output"}
# Basecalled input for the data set, first searches for .fastq, then for .bam (with .bam some headers a bit different, it's better to use .fastq)
raw_reads_folder <- file.path("Data/Raw_data", dataset_name)
dorado_input_reads <- list.files(raw_reads_folder, pattern = "\\.fastq$", full.names = TRUE) #searches for files ending with .fastq
if (length(dorado_input_reads) == 0) dorado_input_reads <- list.files(raw_reads_folder, pattern = "\\.bam$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(dorado_input_reads) != 1) stop(sprintf("Expected one .fastq (or one .bam) file in %s, found %d", raw_reads_folder, length(dorado_input_reads)))

# Running dorado command, runs only if run_dorado is TRUE
dorado_command <- sprintf("dorado demux --kit-name %s --output-dir %s --emit-fastq --no-trim %s",
    shQuote(kit_name), shQuote(dorado_output_folder), shQuote(dorado_input_reads)) # Wraps it in quotes
cat("Running:\n", dorado_command, "\n\n")
dorado_start <- Sys.time()
dorado_exit_status <- system(dorado_command) # Runs it as a terminal command
if (dorado_exit_status != 0) stop("dorado demux failed, see the output above")
log_time("dorado demux (all barcodes)", dorado_start)
  
```



## Dorado output Unnesting
These files are automatically nested a couple of folders deep by the MinKNOW software. The next chunk finds every barcode's .fastq file automatically and copies it flat to Data/Processed_data/dataset_name/Demultiplexed_sequence_data/Dorado_demultiplexed_by_sample as barcode01.fastq, barcode02.fastq, ... for ease of use later.
This part moves the actual .fastq files from their automatically nested position (several folders deep, the run folder name changes every time dorado runs) to the Dorado_demultiplexed_by_sample folder as barcodeXX.fastq.

```{r Dorado_Output_Unnesting}
# Finds every .fastq file in Dorado’s output folder
nested_fastq_files <- list.files(dorado_output_folder, pattern = "\\.fastq$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
nested_fastq_files <- nested_fastq_files[dirname(nested_fastq_files) != dorado_output_folder] # skips any earlier copies from previous runs

flatten_start <- Sys.time()
for (barcode_number in barcode_numbers) {
  barcode_fastq_files <- nested_fastq_files[basename(dirname(nested_fastq_files)) == paste0("barcode", barcode_number)]

  if (length(barcode_fastq_files) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("barcode%s: no .fastq file found in %s\n", barcode_number, dorado_output_folder))
    next
  }
  if (length(barcode_fastq_files) > 1) { # if there are several Dorado files inside the folder it uses the newest
    barcode_fastq_files <- barcode_fastq_files[order(file.mtime(barcode_fastq_files), decreasing = TRUE)]
    cat(sprintf("barcode%s: multiple .fastq files found, using the newest: %s\n", barcode_number, barcode_fastq_files[1]))
  }

  # trimmed destination is "barcode01...24.fastq"
  flat_fastq_path <- file.path(dorado_output_folder, sprintf("barcode%s.fastq", barcode_number))
  copy_success <- file.copy(barcode_fastq_files[1], flat_fastq_path, overwrite = TRUE)
  if (!copy_success) cat(sprintf("barcode%s: copy failed (%s -> %s)\n", barcode_number, barcode_fastq_files[1], flat_fastq_path))
}

# the unclassified reads are copied the same way just for uniformity, they are not used in the later chunks
unclassified_fastq_files <- nested_fastq_files[basename(dirname(nested_fastq_files)) == "unclassified"]
if (length(unclassified_fastq_files) == 0) {
  cat(sprintf("unclassified: NO .fastq FILE FOUND in %s\n", dorado_output_folder))
} else {
  unclassified_fastq_files <- unclassified_fastq_files[order(file.mtime(unclassified_fastq_files), decreasing = TRUE)] # Newest first again
  copy_success <- file.copy(unclassified_fastq_files[1], file.path(dorado_output_folder, "unclassified.fastq"), overwrite = TRUE)
  if (!copy_success) cat(sprintf("unclassified: COPY FAILED (%s)\n", unclassified_fastq_files[1]))
}

log_time("file copy, nested->flat (all barcodes)", flatten_start)
```



## Timing Summary

```{r Timing_Summary}
# timing breakdown for speed optimization analysis
stage01_timing <- do.call(rbind, timing_log)
write_tsv(stage01_timing, file.path(demultiplexed_folder, "Dorado_demultiplexed_by_sample/timing_log_01.tsv"))
stage01_timing$step_type <- sub(".*: ", "", stage01_timing$step)
stage01_timing_summary <- aggregate(seconds ~ step_type, data = stage01_timing, sum)
stage01_timing_summary$seconds <- round(stage01_timing_summary$seconds, 2)
stage01_timing_summary
```
